row.pitchIndex: uint8 source frequency-table index, not MIDI
row.origins: canonical event indices for provenance only; never synthesis instructions

order.pattern: 00..3F selects pointer and retains pattern cursor
order.wrap: FF resets row/order/pattern cursors only; then consumes order0 in the same call
order.stop: FE enters global stop/clearing path; static only in this title window

scheduling.tempo: Decrement uint8; reload2 on negative result. Process row counters only when countdown equals reload.
scheduling.row: Decrement uint8; select a row when result has bit7 set. Otherwise perform body/gate path.
scheduling.observedDuration: All reloads<=67: next row begins (reload+1)*3 calls later. Do not extrapolate that formula to signed-byte reloads>=128.

contextualRules.prefixPriority: Initial F -> glide -> optional sound -> duration/continuation -> arpeggio -> note; helper continuations re-enter specific stages, not a range-only lexer.
contextualRules.glide: Packed control, raw base, raw target occupy consecutive bytes, but executed reads are control,target,base. Both pitches add transpose modulo256.
contextualRules.duration: First high-bit duration sets (byte&3F)-1. Exact E0 after its helper re-enters glide. Otherwise one high-bit extension adds byte&7F; another high-bit helper value re-enters prefix parsing.
contextualRules.endPeek: After initialization, increment cursor and peek. FF immediately resets cursor and decrements repeat/advances order, while the new row still plays its duration.
contextualRules.zero: Raw pitch0 is a valid lookup index; no unconditional rest command is inferred.

missingFixtures.helperFF: A936 FF branches to A8FC without returning through A93E; writer/voice traversal runs with the helper return still on stack. A focused execution must settle resumption effects before general support.
missingFixtures.evenFNonzero: Static A7CE..A7DB sets patch-preserve flag, reads next byte directly and bypasses the normal flag clear when nonzero. No even initial F occurs in the title.
missingFixtures.evenFZero: Static BNE at A7DB is not taken: falls into routing A7DD, reads another byte, calls helper and clears preserve flag. Must not model as ordinary legato.
otherEdges: even-prefix initialization suppression and zero fallthrough

limits: Pure decoding and scheduling from pinned source score bytes; no original driver execution, captured event playback or new render.
Comparison checks read context/bytes, selected pointers, row reloads, transitions and named sequencing state; not instruction timing, full CPU/RAM, synthesis or sound.
Helper FF tail branch and even initial F prefixes do not occur in the retained title. This decoder rejects them pending focused fixtures.
Semantic pitch indices are source lookup indices, not MIDI notes; glide control remains packed and instrument selection awaits the synthesis contract.
actionCheckScope: Full-window helper-entry accumulators verify sound/duration/arpeggio assignments and glide target arithmetic; five opening note stores independently match canonical instruction rows. Exact row base-pitch stores outside the opening are not separately observed by the existing form hooks.
